bio.text: Stacey Plaskett represents the At-Large Congressional District of the U.S. Virgin Islands in the U.S. House of Representatives and is serving her sixth term.

Before Congress she was counsel to a private equity firm and General Counsel to the U.S. Virgin Islands Economic Development Authority, and she began her legal career as an Assistant District Attorney in the Bronx.
She attended Choate Rosemary Hall, earned her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University and her J.D. from American University's Washington College of Law.
